line: Get Straight (Straight) I can’t get no straighter (Nah, hold on)
vault_lines: I can't get no straighter (Nah, hold on)
meaning: Pop Smoke is a sanctioned member of 823 GSC, a Crip set under the Woo umbrella. “GSC” originally stood for “Gangster Stone Crips” but later became “Get Straight Cash”.
